title: Generative Modeling: A Review
abstract: arXiv:2501.05458v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We organize the generative-modeling literature around three classes of generators, corresponding to three distinct inferential tasks: estimating counterfactual outcome distributions in causal inference, recovering posteriors from simulated parameter--outcome pairs, and forming predictive outcome distributions. The unifying representation relies on the noise outsourcing theorem of Kallenberg, which expresses a conditional distribution as a deterministic function of its inputs and an independent noise variable. translated_abstract: arXiv:2501.05458v3 公告类型：替换交叉  摘要：我们围绕三类生成器来组织生成式建模文献，这三类生成器对应三种不同的推断任务：估计因果推断中的反事实结果分布、从模拟参数-结果对中恢复后验分布，以及形成预测结果分布。统一表示依赖于Kallenberg的噪声外包定理，该定理将条件分布表示为输入和独立噪声变量的确定性函数。在此组织框架内，我们开发了生成式贝叶斯计算方法，这是一种参数-结果类方法：一个分位数神经网络，在弹球损失下基于模拟对进行训练，直接针对参数的后验分布，无需可逆架构或密度评估，并且在交换参数和结果的角色后，同样可作为预测生成器。我们通过示例说明了该框架。
tldr: 本文提出了一种统一生成式建模框架，将三类生成器（反事实推断、后验恢复和预测）基于噪声外包定理组织，并开发了生成式贝叶斯计算方法，通过分位数神经网络直接估计后验，无需复杂架构。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified framework for generative modeling, organizing three generator classes (counterfactual inference, posterior recovery, and prediction) via the noise outsourcing theorem, and develops generative Bayesian computation using a quantile neural network to directly estimate posteriors without complex architectures.
